resource: One encoded normative ANL-01 EventEnvelope carrying event type 2 operation npc_trade, including payload
allocation_impact: Check the encoded or borrowed envelope length before retaining, decoding, batching or publishing; ANL01-EVENT-ENVELOPE-BYTES (262,144 B) still applies on top. Migration 0082 admits a stored envelope above the one-item 9,216 B only for an NPC trade event of the same transaction (up to this row) or a fee event (up to DUR03-RL-07-FEE-BURN-ENVELOPE-BYTES), and sets the stored column ceiling to this row.
boundary_tests: the measured worst-case envelope (128-byte build id) is exactly 27,408 B and accepted
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/npc_trade.rs (in-transaction NPC trade: plan and usage checked before any write; migration 0082 re-proves the lines at commit)
notes: NPC-0 §4 command 8 NPC_TRADE_INTENT and §5.5 (NPC_SINGLE_TRADE_COMMIT_V1); NPC trade shape only, the one-item DUR03-RL-01..08 and fee DUR03-RL-*-FEE-BURN rows are unchanged; registered by OTV2-20261013-npc-trade-1. BUY: up to 20 coin BURN lines of the gold fee plan (FeeBurnCause::NpcTrade), up to 2 change MINTs and the item MINT; SELL: one item BURN and up to 3 coin MINTs.
